about: DATA for tools/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map: every refusal's words. The tool keeps nothing and reads nothing: the starter map (settings), the person's own map rows (map_rows) and their pursuits (pursuits) are its input.

words.no_settings: Hand in settings: the starter map ({ areas: [...], list: { id, label, title_field, fields }, words: { ... } }).
words.bad_pursuits: pursuits is a list of { title, areas: [area id] }; read the person's pursuit records and hand them in.
words.bad_settings: settings is the starter map: { areas: [...], list: { id, label, title_field, fields }, words: { ... } }.
words.bad_map_rows: map_rows is the list of rows of the person's own map list: [{ id, title?, values }].
